source: type Unbox = <T>(x: { [P in keyof T]: { value: T[P] } }) => T; type NumberUnbox = (x: { a: { value: number } }) => { a: number }; type WrongUnbox = (x: { a: { value: number } }) => { a: string }; interface MakePartial<T> { value: Partial<T> } type NativePartial = MakePartial<{ a: number; b: string }>; type PlainPartial = { value: { a?: number; b?: string } };
